interface.title: Ascaris (TEI editor for digital scholarly editions)
interface.field: Digital humanities / textual scholarship (historical documents, named-entity annotation, TEI encoding)
interface.stage_of_work: Building an edition: getting the source text in, marking and reconciling named entities, describing the edition with metadata, then publishing it as TEI P5 XML
interface.what_it_is_for: A scholar loads a source text, marks mentions of persons, places, works, organizations, events and terms that become linkable entities, merges coreferent entities, annotates mentions, fills in bibliographic metadata and exports the edition as TEI P5 XML.

data.note: I uploaded sample-document.txt (a four-paragraph passage on Mazzini, Cattaneo and Milan in 1848) as document 1, 'Mazzini letters (sample)'. I also typed a short Garibaldi passage into the Create form to make document 2, which I later deleted from the Home list. No image file was available, so the facsimile upload got only the .txt file, and the editor rejected it.

features.name: Span-to-entity tagging toolbar
features.general: Highlight a passage in a text and assign it one of a fixed set of categories. The passage becomes a coloured inline chip and a record is created in a categorised side list
features.specific: Select text in the Text tab and press Person/Place/Work/Organization/Event/Term. The span becomes a coloured chip with a type icon, and an entity card with a mention count appears under People/Places/Works/Organizations/Events/Terms
steps: select a span by dragging or double-clicking a word
press the category button
the span becomes a coloured chip with an icon
an entity card appears in the matching side-panel tab with count 1
press × on the card to remove the entity and turn the chip back into plain text
serves_tasks: Tag spans of text as typed entity mentions

features.name: Drag-to-merge entity cards (coreference resolution)
features.general: Combine two records that refer to the same thing by dropping one onto the other. The result keeps all name variants and all linked occurrences
features.specific: In a side-panel tab, drag an entity card onto another card of the same type. The cards fuse into one entity that shows both labels and a mention count of 2, and both text mentions point to the same entity in the export
steps: mark two mentions separately so there are two cards
drag one card onto the other
one card remains, showing both labels with the drop target's label first
the export shows one <person> with two <persName>s, and both <ref>s target it
serves_tasks: Merge two records that refer to the same real-world referent

features.name: Entity record editor with authority link
features.general: Open a record to edit its name variants and attach an external authority identifier, which travels with the record into exports
features.specific: Click an entity card to expand Label fields (one per variant) and an Authority record field (VIAF/GeoNames URI), then press Submit. The card header chips update, and the export gets sameAs on the person/place
steps: click the entity card header
edit any Label variant
paste an authority URI into Authority record
press Submit
the card header shows the updated labels
serves_tasks: Link an entity to an external authority record and edit its name variants

features.name: Per-mention annotation dialog
features.general: Attach one or more structured notes (text, language, motivation, license, timestamps) to a single occurrence in a text
features.specific: Click a mention chip to open 'Annotations for X'. Press Add to create a collapsible 'Annotation n-m' form with Text, Language (it/en), Motivation (W3C Web Annotation motivations), Rights (CC licences) and Created/Modified timestamps. Submit or Delete each annotation
steps: click a coloured mention chip
press Add
fill Text and choose Language, Motivation and Rights
press Submit (Modified at updates)
press Add again for another annotation, or Delete to remove one
close the dialog; the annotation is exported in standOff listAnnotation targeting the mention's ref
serves_tasks: Attach a typed, licensed note to one occurrence in the text

features.name: Repeatable-section metadata form
features.general: Describe a resource with a form whose sections each hold any number of rows added with + and removed with −, saved together
features.specific: Metadata tab: Title (with language), Responsibility (surname, name, authority, role), Abstract, Publication authority (role), Publication place (with authority), Publication date, Identifier (ISBN/ISSN/DOI/URI/VIAF/ESTC/OCLC), Category (Document/Book/Letter), Creation date, License (CC/MIT/BSD/GPL/LGPL plus free text), Source, Additional notes. Save Changes writes them into the teiHeader
steps: press + under a section to add a row
fill the row's fields and dropdowns
press + again for another row (for example a second-language title)
press − to drop a row
press Save Changes; values persist after reload and appear in the teiHeader
serves_tasks: Record titles, responsibilities, abstract, identifiers, category, license, source and publication details

features.name: Document intake: type or upload
features.general: Start a new working document either by pasting text or by uploading a file, each with a title, and land directly in the editor
features.specific: New Document page: Create (Title + Content + Save) or Upload (Title + Choose a file… .txt/.docx/.pdf + Upload). Both redirect to /document/N/edit
steps: type a title
paste text into Content, or choose a file
press Save or Upload
the editor opens with the text, ready for tagging
serves_tasks: Load a source text from a file
Start an edition by pasting or typing text

features.name: TEI XML export
features.general: Serialize the annotated text, its entity lists, annotations and metadata into a standard XML interchange file
features.specific:
Download > XML-TEI writes document_N.xml with: a teiHeader (titleStmt, extent counts, publicationStmt, sourceDesc, profileDesc); a body of

s with ; and a standOff with listPerson, listPlace, listBibl, listOrg, listEvent, list type=listTerm and listAnnotation. Only lists with entries are written. The screens show the menu; the contents were checked in downloads/document_1.xml and downloads/document_2.xml
steps: open the Download menu
choose XML-TEI
the file document_N.xml is downloaded
inspect: merged entities, sameAs authority links, annotations and header metadata are present
serves_tasks: Export the edition in a standard structured format and check its contents

features.name: Document list with open and delete
features.general: A table of one's working documents with timestamps, a link to reopen each, and a confirmed delete
features.specific: Home > My Documents: ID, title link, Created at, Updated at and a Delete button that asks for confirmation before removing the row
steps: open Home to see the My Documents table
click a title to reopen the document in the editor
press Delete on a row
accept the confirmation; the row is removed
serves_tasks: Find, reopen or remove an edition
